facts.value: Preserve project truth and institutional memory across sessions, developers, releases, and handoffs.

facts.impact: Resume, Session Close, handoff, and roadmap work must preserve this mission.

gaps.truth_boundary: This gap records missing evidence and does not predict the eventual result.
